lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid-like arrangement with semi-regular spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, where the high-luminance circular features are centered within these vertical bands to form grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Higher density of reduced-diameter high-luminance blobs on the pectoral fin surface compared to the lateral flank; presence of multiple elongated low-luminance silhouettes (Echeneidae) ventral and posterior to the pectoral fin.
